article_content: New guidelines for managing hypertension suggest that individuals aged 60 or older may be able to tolerate higher blood pressure readings than previously thought. The traditional goal for doctors has been to keep patients' blood pressure below 140/90, but the new guidelines suggest that for people over 60, a reading of 150/90 is acceptable. This change could mean that many patients currently on medication might no longer need it, potentially affecting millions of people worldwide.

See muudatus võib tähendada, et paljud praegu ravimit võtvad patsiendid ei pruugi seda enam vajada, mõjutades potentsiaalselt miljoneid inimesi kogu maailmas.

article_content: When my first child was born, I faced the harsh reality of no guaranteed maternity leave in the US. Some states have maternity or parental leave laws, but Texas doesn't. The federal Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) provides 12 weeks of unpaid leave, but I wasn't eligible. I had only four weeks of paid leave. My family eventually moved to Europe, where I enjoyed nine months of maternity leave with my second and third sons. I found significant differences between my experiences in the US and Europe. In the US, there's pressure to return to work quickly, while in Europe, family is prioritized. My experience in Europe allowed me to extend my leave and maintain job security. The biggest difference was the support and understanding I received in Europe, which made a significant impact on my family and me.

Föderaalne Perekonna ja Meditsiinilise Puhkuse Seadus (FMLA) võimaldab 12 nädalat tasustamata puhkust, kuid mina ei olnud selleks abikõlblik. Mul oli vaid neli nädalat tasustatud puhkust. article_content: The Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) has denied additional aid to the town of West, Texas, following deadly explosions at a fertilizer plant in April. Local and state officials have criticized the decision, accusing President Barack Obama of breaking his promise to help the community. Rick Perry and Attorney General Greg Abbott expressed disappointment, with Abbott saying that 'President Obama's FEMA has denied our state and our neighbors the necessary opportunities to rebuild critical infrastructure.' The town is still in need of '$17 million' to repair damaged infrastructure and the school system requires around '$100 million' for rebuilding and temporary housing.

Kuberner Rick Perry ja peaprokurör Greg Abbott avaldasid pettumust, Abbott ütles, et 'president Obama FEMA on meie osariigile ja meie naabritele keeldunud vajalikest võimalustest kriitilise tähtsusega infrastruktuuri taastamiseks.' article_content: A December rampage that killed hundreds in the Democratic Republic of Congo went largely unreported due to a lack of communications in the remote area, a United Nations official said on Sunday. The Lord's Resistance Army carried out a brutal campaign in northeastern Congo over four days, killing at least 321 people, according to Human Rights Watch. Rebels also abducted 250 others, including at least 80 children, when they attacked villages in the Makombo area. Alan Doss, a United Nations Special Representative for Congo, confirmed the massacre. The United Nations was made aware of the attacks in December and confirmed some deaths in January. 'The area is remote; there's no intelligence or communications, so we had to cross-check,' Doss said. The United Nations confirmed more than 100 deaths, although they couldn't corroborate the exact number reported by Human Rights Watch. The Lord's Resistance Army, led by Joseph Kony, has been accused of killing, abducting, and mutilating people in the region. The Makombo massacre is the deadliest documented attack by the LRA since the rampages around Christmas 2008.

Lordi Vastupanu Armee viis läbi jõhkra kampaania Kongo kirdeosas nelja päeva jooksul, tappes vähemalt 321 inimest, teatab Inimõiguste Vaatch. Mässulised röövisid ka 250 inimest, sealhulgas vähemalt 80 last, kui nad ründasid Makombo piirkonna külasid. Alan Doss, ÜRO Kongo eriesindaja, kinnitas veresauna. ÜRO sai rünnakutest teada detsembris ja kinnitas mõned surmad jaanuaris. 'Piirkond on väga eraldatud; puudub luure ja side, seega pidime kontrollima,' ütles Doss. ÜRO kinnitas üle 100 surma, kuigi nad ei saanud Inimõiguste Vaatchi teatatud täpset arvu kinnitada. Lordi Vastupanu Armee, mida juhib Joseph Kony, on süüdistatud piirkonnas inimeste tapmises, röövimises ja vigastamises. Makombo veresaun on LRA kõige ohvriterohkem dokumenteeritud rünnak jõulude aegu toimunud 2008. aasta rünnakute järel.

article_content: Tijuana, Mexico (CNN) -- The Mexican army discovered a large marijuana plantation hidden among tomato stalks, officials announced Thursday. Gen. Alfonso Duarte Mugica stated that the plantation, located six hours south of Tijuana in Ensenada, Baja California, is 168 times larger than the soccer field in Mexico City's Azteca Stadium, spanning 120 hectares (about 300 acres). Marijuana plants, some reaching 2.5 meters in height, were concealed among the tomatoes. During the operation, authorities detained six individuals. Gen. Duarte noted that the seizure would cost drug traffickers 1.8 billion pesos ($153 million). A total of 250 soldiers will destroy the seized drugs within the next week. article_content: It's been less than 24 hours since OpenAI announced that its CEO Sam Altman was fired because the board no longer had 'confidence in his ability' to lead, citing that Altman was 'not consistently candid in his communications.' Uute detailide ilmnedes kirjeldavad mõned seda juhtimise vahetust kui 'riigipööret' või 'vaenulikku ülevõtmist,' New York Timesi taskuhäälingus Hard Fork ajakirjanik Kevin Roose sõnul. article_content: Manchester United's defense of the English Premier League title was dealt another significant blow on Saturday as David Moyes' side lost 1-0 to Newcastle United at Old Trafford. This was United's second home defeat in three days and their fifth of the campaign, matching their total home losses in the entire previous season when they won their record 20th English championship. Trailing leaders Arsenal by 12 points, United remained in ninth place, while Newcastle moved up to sixth after winning at Old Trafford for the first time in 41 years. Yohan Cabaye scored just after the hour mark, securing three points for Newcastle with a goal set up by Moussa Sissoko's cutback. David Moyes stated, 'I stand firm that we'll be very close to it and I hope we're in and around it when it comes to the end of the season,' indicating his belief that the title challenge was not over. Moyes requested patience from Manchester United fans, who are accustomed to success under Alex Ferguson.

See oli Unitedi teine kodukaotus kolme päeva jooksul ja viies sel hooajal, mis vastab nende kodukaotuste koguarvule eelmisel hooajal, kui nad võitsid oma rekordilise 20. Inglise meistritiitli. Liidriks olevast Arsenalist 12 punkti maha jäädes püsis United üheksandal kohal, samal ajal kui Newcastle tõusis kuuendale kohale pärast võitu Old Traffordil esimest korda 41 aasta jooksul. Yohan Cabaye lõi värava vahetult pärast tunni märki, kindlustades Newcastlel Moussa Sissoko tagasiandest saadud väravaga kolm punkti. David Moyes ütles: 'Ma olen kindel, et me oleme sellele väga lähedal ja loodan, et hooaja lõpuks oleme selle lähedal,' viidates oma veendumusele, et tiitlivõitlus pole veel läbi. Moyes palus kannatlikkust Manchester Unitedi fännidelt, kes on Alex Fergusoni juhtimisel harjunud edu nägema.

article_content: Cameron Douglas, the 32-year-old son of actor Michael Douglas, has pleaded guilty to possessing drugs in his prison cell. Douglas is currently serving a five-year prison sentence for drug dealing and now faces an additional 20 years for the latest charges. An investigation found drugs in his cell that tested positive for cocaine and heroin. According to Assistant U.S. Attorney Justin Anderson, one substance found was methadone, a drug used to facilitate withdrawal from heroin. Douglas admitted struggling with addictions to heroin, cocaine, and alcohol, expressing remorse. Michael Douglas stated that his son accepts responsibility and is still not cured of his addiction.

Tema kongist leiti uurimise käigus narkootikume, mille hulgas olid kokaiin ja heroiin. Ameerika Ühendriikide abiprokurör Justin Anderson märkis, et üks leitud ainetest oli metadoon, mida kasutatakse heroiinisõltuvusest võõrutamisel. Douglas tunnistas oma sõltuvust heroiinist, kokaiinist ja alkoholist ning väljendas kahetsust. Michael Douglas kinnitas avalduses, et tema poeg võtab oma tegude eest vastutuse ning on endiselt võitluses sõltuvusega.

article_content: Andy Murray began the 2014 season slowly following back surgery, but picked up his game at the French Open. However, he suffered a surprising loss to Grigor Dimitrov at Wimbledon. Murray faced another challenge at the U.S. Open when he battled cramps throughout his body during his match against Robin Haase on Monday. Despite his struggles, Murray managed to win 6-3 7-6 1-6 7-5. Haase failed to capitalize on his opportunities, including a break chance in the final game where he netted a routine forehand volley. Boris Becker, Novak Djokovic's coach, noted that Haase was 'incapable of taking his opportunity.' Murray revealed he started cramping after an hour and 45 minutes, which he described as not 'normal.' He struggled with movement and serving but managed to persevere. In other matches, Simona Halep survived a scare to beat Danielle Rose Collins 6-7 6-1 6-2. Top seeds including Agnieszka Radwanska, Angelique Kerber, and Venus Williams also secured victories.

Vaatamata oma raskustele, võitis Murray 6-3 7-6 1-6 7-5. Haase ei suutnud oma võimalustega hakkama saada, sealhulgas viimases mängus, kus ta eksis rutiinses forehandi lendpallil. Boris Becker, Novak Djokovici treener, märkis, et Haase oli 'võimetu oma võimalust kasutama.' Murray avaldas, et tema krampimine algas pärast ühte tunni ja 45 minutit, mida ta kirjeldas kui mitte 'normaalset.' Ta nägi vaeva liikumisega ja servi, kuid suutis siiski vastu pidada. article_content: After years of quietly conceding defeat in our battle for wardrobe space, my husband Tom has finally snapped. Perhaps he'd overheard me grumble 'I don't have anything to wear!' one too many times. Or he had stumbled across the summer dresses I've hung on his clothes rail to make way for my winter purchases. Determined to prove I have far more clothes than I need, he decided to compile an inventory. Charlotte Kemp's husband, Tom, sorted through her huge collection of coats, dresses, and trousers and put similar items into piles. While I was out one day last week, he sorted through my vast collection of coats, jackets, dresses, skirts, and trousers. When I returned home, I was stunned to discover a long line of near-identical winter boots in the hallway. On the bed were piles of identical T-shirts, a mountain of long-sleeved tops, and jeans, at least 20 black dresses, and two dozen jackets. I stood there in silence, taking it all in. There were no other words for it: I'd been 'wardrobe shamed'. Not only had Tom made it glaringly obvious I have far too much of everything, he had cast a spotlight on something even more absurd: I buy the same thing over and over again.

Võib-olla oli ta kuulnud mind korduvalt pomisevat 'Mul pole midagi kanda!'. Või oli ta komistanud suvised kleidid, mille olin tema riideriidele riputanud, et teha ruumi talvistele ostudele. article_content: In the online universe, where a great deal of influence is wielded by those who provide fitness, make-up, financial, and other kinds of advice, Ankit Baiyanpuria is a person of some renown. The 25-year-old fitness 'influencer' has a following of over 5 million on Instagram and 1.82 lakh on YouTube. These numbers contributed to Baiyanpuria's appearance in a 'Swachhata hi Seva' campaign video, released on Gandhi Jayanti eve, alongside Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Critics of social media often use the term 'influenza' to describe influencers like Baiyanpuria, acknowledging their reach. Many influencers, like Kusha Kapila, Ranveer Allahbadia, and Bhuvan Bam, now have recognition once reserved for top stars. In the new media landscape, influencers are moving into spaces traditional media has vacated. Baiyanpuria's video with the PM is not unusual. For influencers, this recognition can mean movie roles, book deals, and exclusive interviews. Their credentials may not be traditional, but they're gaining recognition, especially as conventional qualifications are criticised as products of privilege. For a nation hoping to benefit from its 'demographic dividend', dismissing the power of today's youth idols may not be wise.

Need numbrid panustasid Baiyanpuria osalemisse 'Swachhata hi Seva' kampaania videos koos peaminister Narendra Modiga Gandhi Jayanti eel. Sotsiaalmeedia kriitikud kasutavad mõjutajate kirjeldamiseks terminit 'influenza', tunnistades nende mõju. Paljud mõjutajad, nagu Kusha Kapila, Ranveer Allahbadia ja Bhuvan Bam, on saavutanud tippstaaridele varem reserveeritud tunnustuse. Uues meediamaastikus hõivavad mõjutajad traditsioonilise meedia tühjaks jäänud ruume. Baiyanpuria video koos PM-iga ei ole haruldane. Mõjutajate tunnustus võib tähendada neile filmirolle, raamatute avaldamist ja eksklusiivseid intervjuusid. Nende kvalifikatsioon võib olla ebatraditsiooniline, kuid nad saavad tunnustust, eriti kui tavapäraseid kvalifikatsioone kritiseeritakse privilegeerituse pärast. Rahvale, mis loodab oma 'demograafilisest dividendist' kasu saada, ei ole tark ignoreerida tänaste noorte iidolite mõju.

article_content: The thing that struck me most when my daughter started secondary school in September is how different all the girls in her year look. All shapes and sizes, from 'teeny-tiny waifs' who look like they're barely out of reception, to 'big strapping ones', taller than me, and with all the accessories to match. My daughter herself put it with great excitement: 'Mummy, some of them have got even bigger 'boobs' than you!' Tall, short, stocky, skinny, sporty or 'speccie', they are all special in their own way. All starting out on life's long journey; no longer children but not yet women. They're still, for the most part, mercifully unaware that their appearance matters much. American lingerie brand Victoria's Secret has launched a new billboard advert featuring ten super-skinny models in their underwear. As a mother, I'm keen to keep this 'little parasite' at bay for as long as possible. I don't have women's magazines in the house, and I do my best to promote a positive attitude towards healthy eating and exercise. The latest example of this comes from Victoria's Secret. Ten super-skinny models in push-up bra and pants are used to promote VS's new 'Perfect Body' range. The girls appear to have been stretched even thinner with the help of Photoshop. One of them, a dark-haired girl in a purple set, appears to have the proportions of a Barbie doll. No one expects a brand like Victoria's Secret to advertise its wares on ordinary women. But there's a line between aspiration and 'thinspiration', and this campaign clearly oversteps the mark. The use of the word 'perfect' is not only offensive to the majority of the female population, it's also deeply irresponsible. Three British students are demanding that the company apologise and alter the wording on the advertisement. Young women who model for Victoria's Secret are nicknamed 'Angels'. The advert is a deliberate projection of an ideal of female beauty that is virtually unattainable and deeply damaging. Female self-loathing is a commercial cornerstone of the fashion and beauty industry.

Kõik kujud ja suurused, alates 'väga väikestest habrastest', kes näevad välja nagu nad oleksid vaevu vastuvõtust väljas, kuni 'suurte ja tugevate' tüdrukuteni, kes on pikemad kui mina. Mu enda tütar ütles seda suure elevusega: 'Ema, mõnel neist on isegi suuremad 'rinnad' kui sinul!' Pikad, lühikesed, jässakad, kõhnad, sportlikud või 'prillidega', nad kõik on erilised omal moel. Ameerika aluspesu bränd Victoria's Secret on käivitanud uue reklaamikampaania, millel on kümme üliõhukest modelli nende aluspesus. Kampaanias 'Perfect Body' kasutatakse üliõhukesi mudeleid, et reklaamida nende uusimat tootesarja.

article_content: A recent social experiment in Los Angeles highlights the ongoing issue of racial bias in American society. Jason Roberts and his friend Quentin Brunson conducted the experiment, which involved attempting to break into a car to observe public reactions. When Roberts, who is white, tried to break into the car, he was largely ignored despite the car's alarm blaring. Conversely, when Brunson, who is black, made the attempt, onlookers became suspicious and quickly called the police. The LAPD arrived promptly and detained Brunson, demonstrating a significant disparity in how the two men were treated due to their race. The video seeks to raise awareness about racial disparities in treatment, supported by FBI data on motor vehicle theft. Roberts' real-life experience with a black mechanic inspired the experiment, having noticed different reactions to them when they were locked out of a car.
translated_content: Los Angeleses tehtud sotsiaalne eksperiment näitab, kuidas Ameerikas veel ikka rassism on probleem. Eksperimendis osalesid Jason Roberts ja Quentin Brunson, kes üritasid murda autosse. Kui Roberts, valge mees, seda üritas, ei reageerinud keegi, kuigi auto häire oli kõva. Kui Brunson, must mees, sama tegi, reageerisid möödakäijad kiiresti ja kutsusid politsei. Politsei tuli kiiresti ja võttis Brunsoni kinni, näidates selgelt, kuidas neid erinevalt koheldi nende nahavärvi tõttu. article_content: An 'innovative' drug could 'significantly' protect stroke victims from brain damage. The treatment has shown 'exceptionally' promising results in animal tests, and early results with humans are also 'very encouraging'. There's currently only one effective treatment for stroke. Tissue plasminogen activator (tPA) can dissolve the blood clots that cause a stroke. But it has to be given very soon after symptoms appear, and doctors first have to ensure the stroke wasn't caused by a 'brain hemorrhage', in which case tPA can worsen the situation. Michael Tymianski and his team at the Toronto Western Hospital Research Institute in Canada devised a different stroke treatment, a drug known as a PSD-95 inhibitor. It works by blocking a key protein in the chain reaction leading to brain-cell death. 'By inhibiting this protein, the drug prevents the formation of a toxic free radical called nitric oxide.' As a result, brain cells treated with this drug become more 'resilient' to a stroke. In a new scientific paper published online in Nature, Tymianski published the results of research on macaques. 'Animals treated with the placebo had very large strokes and were very disabled.', 'But those who received the drug had much smaller strokes on their MRI scans and were neurologically much better off.' Those 'encouraging' results led to human trials. Tymianski says 'the top-line results were announced at the International Stroke Conference in New Orleans in February.' Unlike tPA, the PSD-95 inhibitor can help patients with 'hemorrhagic strokes' and may be useful in treating other brain injuries.

Tissue plasminogen activator (tPA) võib lahustada insuldi põhjustanud vereklompe.
